name: Crane Operations Overview
html:
FLEET OPERATIONS

Crane operations overview

Live figures for your fleet and projects

Full dashboard ↗
Loading fleet metrics...
Cranes →Projects →Timesheets →Maintenance →
style: :host{display:block;font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif}.crane-overview{color:#17324a}.crane-banner{background:linear-gradient(115deg,#153e65,#128b9a 65%,#39b99b);border-radius:20px;color:#fff;padding:25px 28px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:15px}.crane-banner span{font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.18em;opacity:.8}.crane-banner h2{font-size:25px;color:#fff;margin:6px 0;font-weight:800}.crane-banner p{margin:0;opacity:.85}.crane-banner a{color:#fff;border:1px solid #ffffff80;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 13px;text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap}.crane-metrics{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;margin:15px 0}.crane-metric{border:1px solid #e7eef3;border-top:4px solid var(--accent);background:#fff;border-radius:14px;padding:18px;box-shadow:0 6px 18px #17324a0b}.crane-metric small{display:block;color:#68808f;font-weight:650}.crane-metric strong{display:block;color:#17324a;font-size:29px;line-height:1.3;margin-top:5px}.crane-loading{padding:20px;color:#68808f}.crane-links{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:9px}.crane-links a{background:#eef8fa;border-radius:10px;color:#087c88;text-decoration:none;font-weight:700;padding:9px 13px;font-size:12px}@media(max-width:850px){.crane-metrics{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}@media(max-width:500px){.crane-banner{display:block}.crane-banner a{display:inline-block;margin-top:14px}.crane-metric strong{font-size:24px}}
script:
const target = root_element.querySelector('.crane-metrics'); frappe.call({method:'heavy_equipment_rental.dashboard.get_crane_dashboard'}).then(({message:d})=>{const cards=[['Total cranes',d.fleet_total,'#1584a6'],['Available today',d.available_today,'#22aa81'],['Reserved today',d.reserved_today,'#efa93d'],['Open projects',d.open_projects,'#9c79e8'],['Billable hours this month',d.hours_this_month,'#468de6'],['Unbilled timesheets',d.unbilled_timesheets,'#f17b6e'],['In maintenance',d.maintenance,'#db6883'],['Upcoming services',d.upcoming_maintenance_count,'#4dafa8']];target.innerHTML=cards.map(([label,value,color])=>`
${frappe.utils.escape_html(__(label))}${new Intl.NumberFormat(undefined,{maximumFractionDigits:1}).format(value||0)}
`).join('');}).catch(()=>{target.textContent=__('Unable to load crane metrics. Please refresh.');});
